verdict.rationale: Quo ships its own built-in AI agent, Sona, which takes over answering calls when the team can't, captures details and hands the conversation back. AI transcription, summaries and call tags add more built-in automation. The plain-English task delegation shown in the MCP docs runs through external agents (Claude, ChatGPT), not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant users can hand arbitrary tasks to (e.g. send texts, update contacts), documentation of how Sona is configured and what it can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
